description: This file defines a configuration structure `SwabbleConfig` and related components for a voice assistant application, including audio settings, wake word detection, command hooks, logging, transcripts, and speech settings. It also provides functionality to load and save the configuration from/to a JSON file.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads a `SwabbleConfig` instance from a specified file path, decoding JSON data.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves a `SwabbleConfig` instance to a specified file path, encoding it as JSON.
